method: Visual inspection of locally downloaded course video frames extracted by ffmpeg; no generated covers or reconstructed artwork. Bibliographic source matching is a separate step.
scope: Active reading/holding/displaying of books and named spoken titles. Incidental background shelf/table books are not promoted into confirmed recommendations.

entries.title: Spot Goes to School
entries.visualCues: Teacher actively holds pale blue board-book cover. Title Spot Goes to School visible; yellow Spot with school scene. Author/imprint not readable in this frame.

entries.title: Zoo
entries.visualCues: Actively held cover, white ZOO title on black panel surrounded by black-and-white vertical stripes; family portrait underneath; Anthony Browne printed along bottom.

entries.title: Little Beauty
entries.visualCues: Actively held gorilla-face cover; Little Beauty title at lower edge and Anthony Browne vertically at right visible.

entries.title: A Walk in the Park
entries.visualCues: Yellow/olive cover with four characters at edges and centered stacked A Walk in the Park title; author name faint at top.

entries.title: Changes
entries.visualCues: Pale yellow/orange cover with CHANGES title, kettle illustration and upper author lettering visible.

entries.title: Willy's Pictures
entries.visualCues: Pale cover, title Willy's Pictures, collage of art figures with chimpanzee; author name above title.

entries.title: My Dad
entries.visualCues: My Dad title in blue beside a man in a yellow patterned dressing gown; teacher actively flips through book stack.

entries.title: My Mum
entries.visualCues: Spoken My mom at 163.96s while mother in floral clothes cover is flipped; title obscured by hands/motion. Author-family context is Anthony Browne but exact edition requires external bibliographic match.

entries.title: My Brother
entries.visualCues: Light blue cover with orange My Brother lettering, Anthony Browne above, and striped-shirt child standing with arms raised.

entries.title: Love You Forever
entries.visibleAuthor: Robert Munsch; illustrated by Sheila McGraw
entries.visualCues: Clear pale blue cover: LOVE YOU FOREVER; WRITTEN BY ROBERT MUNSCH; ILLUSTRATED BY SHEILA McGRAW. Child sitting beside toilet and unrolled paper.

entries.title: The Big Purple Book of Beginner Books
entries.visualCues: Purple/grey cover with The Big Purple title visible, lower title partially covered by hand. Spoken full title at 511–516s. Cat-in-the-Hat circular mark is a Beginner Books imprint mark and not evidence that The Cat in the Hat is a separate recommended book.

entries.title: Maisy Goes to Bed
entries.visualCues: Brown/orange cover; full Maisy Goes to Bed title; Maisy in blue star pajamas holding a toy; Lucy Cousins along lower edge; white cloud reads A pull-the-tab book.
entries.editionStatus: pull-the-tab edition design confirmed; exact ISBN/printing not established

entries.title: My Car
entries.visualCues: Full cover visible: My Car in green on yellow background; red car with blue-capped driver; Byron Barton at right. Rounded-corner board book.
entries.editionStatus: board-book design visible; exact ISBN/printing not established

entries.title: Spot Stays Overnight
entries.visualCues: Purple cover clearly reads Spot Stays Overnight with Eric Hill below. This is the title printed in the actual course copy; do not silently substitute Spot Sleeps Over.
entries.editionStatus: US-title/design visible; exact ISBN/printing not established

entries.title: Spot Goes to the Farm
entries.visualCues: Green front cover partially visible under the child’s hand: Spot Go... / the Far... with yellow Spot. Interior farm/animals and Here they are! match context. Full title must also be matched to publisher source because several central letters are occluded.

entries.title: Put Me in the Zoo
entries.visualCues: Clear interior has large yellow red-spotted animal beside zoo gate; text put me out this way / I should be in / I want to stay. No cover/title or imprint shown in inspected frames.
entries.editionStatus: edition-unconfirmed; title from distinctive interior text/artwork plus bibliographic verification

entries.title: The Very Hungry Caterpillar
entries.visualCues: Teacher refers to Hungry Caterpillar while standing by bookcase. No individual caterpillar cover is brought forward in inspected frame.
entries.editionStatus: edition-unconfirmed; do not claim an ISBN from this frame

entries.title: Little Red Riding Hood
entries.visualCues: Child/parent read Little Red Riding Hood passage. Wolf/grandmother, hunter and cottage story interiors visible through 402s; no cover, author, illustrator or imprint shown. Same reading clip occurs in lesson08 at1280–1320.

entries.title: Unidentified phonics reader: The tin fell on the mat
entries.visualCues: Visible printed sentences The tin fell on the mat. / A mess on the dog. / A mess on the rug.; paint/tin accident illustrations. Title and author not visible. Pets and Circus Shapes lie on table as background, not the book being read.

bibliographicFollowup.note: Oxford Reading Tree / Floppy’s Phonics candidate by Roderick Hunt. Video reads tin; modern edition excerpts may use pan/jam. No ISBN inferred.

entries.title: Unidentified Spot boat/holiday story
entries.visualCues: Child reads and opens flaps with Spot, boat, wave and dog-overboard scenes around500–549s. Front cover never presented in inspected frames; do not claim Spot Goes on Holiday without independent text/page match.

bibliographicFollowup.note: Reviewer matched the boat/overboard/towel/new-friend sequence to publisher descriptions. The video itself still does not show a cover.

entries.title: A Fly Went By (text-match candidate)
entries.visualCues: Child recites in a car; no physical book/cover/title appears. ASR cat/frog/dog sequence can be checked against publisher text; visual confirmation of the edition is impossible here.

entries.title: Unidentified alphabet picture book
entries.visualCues: Interior sequence C/cat, E/elephant, F/fish, G/girl, H/house, I/iron, J/jug. I image was checked at original resolution: iron, not ice cream. No cover/title page visible.

unverifiedEditionPolicy: Visible cover design is not proof of ISBN, print year or binding variant. Keep uncertain editions explicit.

excludedIncidentalItems.reason: Background books on table, not actively read or named in this clip.
